description: A TwoBoneIk that drives a foot must take the foot's ankle as its ikTarget, as a Limb must (D80 phase 2). The error names the line to add

expectErrors.contains: 'arm_01_L_MOD' has no 'ikTarget' entry in its parentStructure, so the foot's channels would not move the ankle. Add "ikTarget": "foot_00_L_MOD.ankle"
